<script>
import { getResidentInfo } from '../../services/storage'
import { listResidentAttendance, isCheckedInToday } from '../../services/attendance'
import { fetchHistory } from '../../services/history'
import { fetchMessages } from '../../services/message'

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			resident: null,
			todayChecked: false,
			checkinTime: '',
			todo: { pending: 0, review: 0, draft: 0 },
			announcements: [],
			unreadCount: 0,
			loading: false
		}
	},
	computed: {
		gridItems() {
			return [
				{ key: 'checkin', icon: '📅', label: '日常打卡', iconBg: 'bg-blue', route: '/pages/checkin/checkin' },
				{ key: 'leave', icon: '📋', label: '请假申请', iconBg: 'bg-green', route: '/pages/leave/leave' },
				{ key: 'record', icon: '🚗', label: '外出备案', iconBg: 'bg-orange', route: '/pages/record/record' },
				{ key: 'makeup', icon: '🔄', label: '补卡申请', iconBg: 'bg-cyan', route: '/pages/makeup/index' },
				{ key: 'employment', icon: '💼', label: '工作变更', iconBg: 'bg-purple', route: '/pages/employment/change' },
				{ key: 'history', icon: '🔍', label: '申请记录', iconBg: 'bg-pink', route: '/pages/history/history' },
				{ key: 'message', icon: '🔔', label: '消息中心', iconBg: 'bg-indigo', route: '/pages/message/message', badge: this.unreadCount },
				{ key: 'household', icon: '👨‍👩‍👧', label: '家庭信息', iconBg: 'bg-teal', route: '' },
				{ key: 'allocation', icon: '🏠', label: '配租信息', iconBg: 'bg-teal', route: '' }
			]
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.loadDashboard()
	},
	onShow() {
		this.loadDashboard()
	},
	methods: {
		async loadDashboard() {
			this.resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!this.resident || !this.resident.id) return
			if (this.loading) return
			this.loading = true

			try {
				const today = new Date()
				const start = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), 0, 0, 0).toISOString()
				const end = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), 23, 59, 59).toISOString()

				const [checked, attendanceRes, history, messages] = await Promise.all([
					isCheckedInToday(this.resident.id).catch(() => false),
					listResidentAttendance({
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						startDate: start,
						endDate: end,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					fetchHistory({
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						householdId: this.resident.householdId
					}).catch(() => []),
					fetchMessages({
						tab: 'all',
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						householdId: this.resident.householdId
					}).catch(() => [])
				])

				this.todayChecked = checked
				const record = attendanceRes.data[0]
				if (record && record.checkIn) {
					const d = new Date(record.checkIn)
					if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
						this.checkinTime = `${d.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`
					}
				}

				this.announcements = messages.slice(0, 2)
				this.unreadCount = messages.length

				let pending = 0, review = 0, draft = 0
				history.forEach((item) => {
					if (item.isDraft) draft++
					else if (item.isPending || item.variant === 'pending') pending++
					else if (item.variant === 'rejected') review++
				})
				this.todo = { pending, review, draft }
			} catch (e) {
				console.warn('加载工作台数据失败', e)
			} finally {
				this.loading = false
			}
		},
		handleCheckIn() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/checkin' })
		},
		handleGridClick(item) {
			if (!item.route) {
				uni.showToast({ title: '即将上线', icon: 'none' })
				return
			}
			uni.navigateTo({ url: item.route })
		},
		goHistory() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/history/history' })
		},
		goMessage() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/message/message' })
		}
	}
}
</script>

<script>
import { sendSmsOTP } from '../../services/auth'
import { verifyResident } from '../../services/resident'
import { isCheckedInToday } from '../../services/attendance'
import { getResidentInfo, getUserInfo } from '../../services/storage'
import { listResidentLeaves } from '../../services/leave'
import { listResidentRecords } from '../../services/record'

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			checkinStatus: '未打卡',
			leaveStatus: '无',
			recordStatus: '无',
			abnormalCount: 0,
			verifying: false
		}
	},
	onShow() {
		this.resumeCheckinAfterLogin()
		this.refreshStatus()
	},
	methods: {
		goBack() {
			uni.navigateBack()
		},
		async refreshStatus() {
			const resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				return
			}
			try {
				const [checked, leaveRes, recordRes] = await Promise.all([
					isCheckedInToday(resident.id),
					listResidentLeaves({
						residentId: resident.id,
						status: 'COMPLETED',
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					listResidentRecords({
						residentId: resident.id,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] }))
				])
				this.checkinStatus = checked ? '已打卡' : '未打卡'
				this.leaveStatus = leaveRes.data.length ? '请假中' : '无'
				const activeRecord = recordRes.data.find((item) => item.status === 'RECORD_ACTIVE')
				this.recordStatus = activeRecord ? '生效中' : '无'
			} catch (error) {
				// 静默
			}
		},
		async startWechatFacialVerify(resident) {
			if (!resident || !resident.fullName || !resident.idCardNo) {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '缺少实名信息',
					content: '当前用户缺少姓名或身份证号,无法发起微信实人认证。请先在管理端补全实名信息。',
					showCancel: false
				})
				return
			}

			if (this.verifying) {
				return
			}
			this.verifying = true

			try {
				uni.showLoading({ title: '发送验证码...' })
				if (resident.phone) {
					try {
						await sendSmsOTP(resident.phone)
					} catch (otpError) {
						console.warn('OTP 发送失败,继续走人脸核身', otpError)
					}
				}

				uni.showLoading({ title: '拉起人脸核身...' })
				await this.requestFacialVerify(resident)

				uni.showLoading({ title: '校验核身结果...' })
				await verifyResident(resident.facePhoto || '')

				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: '身份验证成功', icon: 'success' })
				setTimeout(() => {
					uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
				}, 1200)
			} catch (error) {
				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: error.message || '身份验证失败', icon: 'none' })
			} finally {
				this.verifying = false
			}
		},
		requestFacialVerify(resident) {
			return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				if (typeof wx === 'undefined' || !wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify) {
					resolve(null)
					return
				}
				wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify({
					name: resident.fullName,
					idCardNumber: resident.idCardNo,
					checkAliveType: 2,
					success: resolve,
					fail: (error) => reject(new Error((error && error.errMsg) || '人脸核身失败'))
				})
			})
		},
		resumeCheckinAfterLogin() {
			const shouldResume = uni.getStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin') === '1'
			if (!shouldResume) {
				return
			}
			uni.removeStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin')
			if (getUserInfo()) {
				this.startCheckin()
			}
		},
		startCheckin() {
			const user = getUserInfo()
			if (!user) {
				uni.setStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin', '1')
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login/login?from=checkin' })
				return
			}

			if (this.checkinStatus === '已打卡') {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '今日已打卡',
					content: '今天已经成功打过卡,无需再次打卡。如需补卡或查看打卡详情,请到「申请记录」页查看。',
					confirmText: '查看记录',
					cancelText: '我知道了',
					success: (res) => {
						if (res.confirm) {
							uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/history/history' })
						}
					}
				})
				return
			}

			const resident = getResidentInfo()

			// #ifndef MP-WEIXIN
			uni.showToast({ title: '当前为非微信环境,直接进入拍照页', icon: 'none' })
			setTimeout(() => {
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
			}, 1200)
			return
			// #endif

			// #ifdef MP-WEIXIN
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
				return
			}
			wx.checkIsSupportFacialRecognition({
				success: () => this.startWechatFacialVerify(resident),
				fail: () => uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
			})
			// #endif
		},
		goToLeave() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/leave/leave' })
		},
		goToRecord() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/record/record' })
		},
		goToMessage() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/message/message' })
		}
	}
}
</script>

					isCheckedInToday(resident.id),
					listResidentLeaves({
						residentId: resident.id,
						status: 'COMPLETED',
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					listResidentRecords({
						residentId: resident.id,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] }))
				])
				this.checkinStatus = checked ? '已打卡' : '未打卡'
				this.leaveStatus = leaveRes.data.length ? '请假中' : '无'
				const activeRecord = recordRes.data.find((item) => item.status === 'RECORD_ACTIVE')
				this.recordStatus = activeRecord ? '生效中' : '无'
			} catch (error) {
				// 静默
			}
		},
		async startWechatFacialVerify(resident) {
			if (!resident || !resident.fullName || !resident.idCardNo) {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '缺少实名信息',
					content: '当前用户缺少姓名或身份证号,无法发起微信实人认证。请先在管理端补全实名信息。',
					showCancel: false
				})
				return
			}

			if (this.verifying) {
				return
			}
			this.verifying = true

			try {
				uni.showLoading({ title: '发送验证码...' })
				if (resident.phone) {
					try {
						await sendSmsOTP(resident.phone)
					} catch (otpError) {
						console.warn('OTP 发送失败,继续走人脸核身', otpError)
					}
				}

				uni.showLoading({ title: '拉起人脸核身...' })
				await this.requestFacialVerify(resident)

				uni.showLoading({ title: '校验核身结果...' })
				await verifyResident(resident.facePhoto || '')

				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: '身份验证成功', icon: 'success' })
				setTimeout(() => {
					uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
				}, 1200)
			} catch (error) {
				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: error.message || '身份验证失败', icon: 'none' })
			} finally {
				this.verifying = false
			}
		},
		requestFacialVerify(resident) {
			return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				if (typeof wx === 'undefined' || !wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify) {
					resolve(null)
					return
				}
				wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify({
					name: resident.fullName,
					idCardNumber: resident.idCardNo,
					checkAliveType: 2,
					success: resolve,
					fail: (error) => reject(new Error((error && error.errMsg) || '人脸核身失败'))
				})
			})
		},
		resumeCheckinAfterLogin() {
			const shouldResume = uni.getStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin') === '1'
			if (!shouldResume) {
				return
			}
			uni.removeStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin')
			if (getUserInfo()) {
				this.startCheckin()
			}
		},
		startCheckin() {
			const user = getUserInfo()
			if (!user) {
				uni.setStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin', '1')
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login/login?from=checkin' })
				return
			}

			if (this.checkinStatus === '已打卡') {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '今日已打卡',
					content: '今天已经成功打过卡,无需再次打卡。如需补卡或查看打卡详情,请到「申请记录」页查看。',
					confirmText: '查看记录',
					cancelText: '我知道了',
					success: (res) => {
						if (res.confirm) {
							uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/history/history' })
						}
					}
				})
				return
			}

			const resident = getResidentInfo()

			// #ifndef MP-WEIXIN
			uni.showToast({ title: '当前为非微信环境,直接进入拍照页', icon: 'none' })
			setTimeout(() => {
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
			}, 1200)
			return
			// #endif

			// #ifdef MP-WEIXIN
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
				return
			}
			wx.checkIsSupportFacialRecognition({
				success: () => this.startWechatFacialVerify(resident),
				fail: () => uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
			})
			// #endif
		},
		goToLeave() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/leave/leave' })
		},
		goToRecord() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/record/record' })
		},
		goToMessage() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/message/message' })
		}
	}
}
</script>

<template>
	<view class="page">
		<!-- 核验中:全屏 loading -->
		<view v-if="checkingVerify" class="status-screen">
			<view class="status-card">
				<view class="status-icon status-icon-loading">⏳</view>
				<text class="status-title">正在校验身份核验状态</text>
				<text class="status-desc">请稍候...</text>
			</view>
		</view>

		<!-- 未核身:全屏拦截 -->
		<view v-else-if="!verified" class="status-screen">
			<view class="status-card">
				<view class="status-icon status-icon-warning">🔒</view>
				<text class="status-title">需要先完成身份核验</text>
				<text class="status-desc">为防止冒用,请先通过微信人脸核身,核身通过后再进入环境拍摄。</text>
				<button class="status-btn" hover-class="btn-pressed" @click="goVerify">去核身</button>
			</view>
		</view>

		<!-- 已核身:正常拍照流程 -->
		<block v-else>
			<!-- 拍摄提示 -->
			<view class="tips-card">
				<view class="tips-icon">📷</view>
				<text class="tips-title">拍摄要求</text>
				<view class="tips-list">
					<text class="tips-item">• 请拍摄清晰的居住环境照片</text>
					<text class="tips-item">• 确保光线充足,画面清晰</text>
					<text class="tips-item">• 至少拍摄1张照片</text>
				</view>
			</view>

			<!-- 照片列表 -->
			<view class="photo-section">
				<text class="section-title">已拍摄照片 ({{ photoList.length }}/9)</text>
				<view class="photo-grid">
					<view
						v-for="(photo, index) in photoList"
						:key="index"
						class="photo-item"
					>
						<image :src="photo" class="photo-img" mode="aspectFill"></image>
						<view class="photo-delete" @click="deletePhoto(index)">
							<text class="delete-icon">×</text>
						</view>
					</view>

					<view
						v-if="photoList.length < 9"
						class="photo-add"
						@click="takePhoto"
					>
						<text class="add-icon">+</text>
						<text class="add-text">添加</text>
					</view>
				</view>
			</view>

			<!-- 底部按钮 -->
			<view class="bottom-section">
				<button
					class="submit-btn"
					:disabled="photoList.length === 0 || submitting"
					:class="{ disabled: photoList.length === 0 || submitting }"
					@click="submitCheckin"
				>
					提交打卡
				</button>
			</view>
		</block>
	</view>
</template>

<script>
import { uploadAttendanceAttachment, submitAttendance } from '../../services/attendance'
import { fetchResidentDetail } from '../../services/resident'
import { getResidentInfo, setResidentInfo } from '../../services/storage'

const VERIFIED_STATUSES = ['VERIFIED', 'ACTIVATED']

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			photoList: [],
			submitting: false,
			verified: false,
			checkingVerify: true
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.ensureVerified()
	},
	onShow() {
		if (!this.verified) {
			this.ensureVerified()
		}
	},
	methods: {
		async ensureVerified() {
			this.checkingVerify = true
			try {
				let resident = getResidentInfo()
				if (resident && resident.id) {
					try {
						const fresh = await fetchResidentDetail(resident.id)
						if (fresh) {
							resident = fresh
							setResidentInfo(fresh)
						}
					} catch (error) {
						// 网络失败时退回本地缓存,继续按缓存状态校验
					}
				}

				this.verified = !!(resident && resident.id && VERIFIED_STATUSES.indexOf(resident.status) !== -1)
			} finally {
				this.checkingVerify = false
			}
		},
		goBack() {
			uni.navigateBack()
		},
		goVerify() {
			// photo-capture 页是从 checkin navigateTo 进来的,直接 navigateBack 回核身页
			const pages = getCurrentPages()
			if (pages && pages.length > 1) {
				uni.navigateBack()
				return
			}
			uni.reLaunch({ url: '/pages/checkin/checkin' })
		},
		takePhoto() {
			if (!this.verified) {
				uni.showToast({ title: '请先完成身份核验', icon: 'none' })
				return
			}
			uni.showActionSheet({
				itemList: ['拍照', '从相册选择'],
				success: (res) => {
					const sourceType = res.tapIndex === 0 ? ['camera'] : ['album']
					this.choosePhotos(sourceType)
				}
			})
		},
		choosePhotos(sourceType) {
			uni.chooseImage({
				count: 9 - this.photoList.length,
				sizeType: ['compressed'],
				sourceType,
				success: (res) => {
					const tempFilePaths = Array.isArray(res.tempFilePaths) ? res.tempFilePaths : []
					this.photoList = this.photoList.concat(tempFilePaths).slice(0, 9)

					if (this.photoList.length >= 9) {
						uni.showToast({ title: '最多上传9张照片', icon: 'none' })
					}
				},
				fail: (err) => {
					if (err && err.errMsg && err.errMsg.includes('cancel')) {
						return
					}
					uni.showToast({ title: '选择照片失败', icon: 'none' })
				}
			})
		},
		deletePhoto(index) {
			uni.showModal({
				title: '提示',
				content: '确定删除这张照片吗？',
				success: (res) => {
					if (res.confirm) {
						this.photoList.splice(index, 1)
					}
				}
			})
		},
		getLocation() {
			return new Promise((resolve) => {
				uni.getLocation({
					type: 'gcj02',
					success: (res) => resolve({
						longitude: Number(res.longitude.toFixed(6)),
						latitude: Number(res.latitude.toFixed(6))
					}),
					fail: () => resolve(null)
				})
			})
		},
		async submitCheckin() {
			if (this.submitting) {
				return
			}

			if (!this.verified) {
				uni.showToast({ title: '请先完成身份核验', icon: 'none' })
				return
			}

			if (this.photoList.length === 0) {
				uni.showToast({ title: '请至少拍摄一张照片', icon: 'none' })
				return
			}

			const resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '请先登录',
					content: '尚未识别到居民信息，请重新登录后再打卡。',
					showCancel: false,
					success: () => uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login/login?from=checkin' })
				})
				return
			}

			this.submitting = true
			try {
				const attachments = []
				for (let i = 0; i < this.photoList.length; i += 1) {
					uni.showLoading({ title: `上传照片 ${i + 1}/${this.photoList.length}` })
					const attachment = await uploadAttendanceAttachment(this.photoList[i], 'environment')
					attachments.push(attachment)
				}

				const location = await this.getLocation()

				uni.showLoading({ title: '提交打卡中...' })
				await submitAttendance({
					residentId: resident.id,
					attendanceType: 'RESIDENCE',
					environment: attachments[0],
					environmentPhotos: attachments,
					location,
					mode: 'MINI_PROGRAM'
				})

				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: '打卡成功', icon: 'success', duration: 2000 })
				setTimeout(() => uni.navigateBack({ delta: 1 }), 2000)
			} catch (error) {
				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: error.message || '提交打卡失败', icon: 'none' })
			} finally {
				this.submitting = false
			}
		}
	}
}
</script>

					:key="item.key"
					class="grid-item"
					@click="handleGridClick(item)"
				>
					<view class="grid-icon" :class="item.iconBg">
						<text class="grid-icon-text">{{ item.icon }}</text>
					</view>

<script>
import { getResidentInfo } from '../../services/storage'
import { listResidentAttendance, isCheckedInToday } from '../../services/attendance'
import { fetchHistory } from '../../services/history'
import { fetchMessages } from '../../services/message'

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			resident: null,
			todayChecked: false,
			checkinTime: '',
			todo: { pending: 0, review: 0, draft: 0 },
			announcements: [],
			unreadCount: 0,
			loading: false
		}
	},
	computed: {
		gridItems() {
			return [
				{ key: 'checkin', icon: '📅', label: '日常打卡', iconBg: 'bg-blue', route: '/pages/checkin/checkin' },
				{ key: 'leave', icon: '📋', label: '请假申请', iconBg: 'bg-green', route: '/pages/leave/leave' },
				{ key: 'record', icon: '🚗', label: '外出备案', iconBg: 'bg-orange', route: '/pages/record/record' },
				{ key: 'makeup', icon: '🔄', label: '补卡申请', iconBg: 'bg-cyan', route: '/pages/makeup/index' },
				{ key: 'employment', icon: '💼', label: '工作变更', iconBg: 'bg-purple', route: '/pages/employment/change' },
				{ key: 'history', icon: '🔍', label: '申请记录', iconBg: 'bg-pink', route: '/pages/history/history' },
				{ key: 'message', icon: '🔔', label: '消息中心', iconBg: 'bg-indigo', route: '/pages/message/message', badge: this.unreadCount },
				{ key: 'invite', icon: '➕', label: '邀请成员', iconBg: 'bg-teal', route: '/pages/invite/send' }
			]
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.loadDashboard()
	},
	onShow() {
		this.loadDashboard()
	},
	methods: {
		async loadDashboard() {
			this.resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!this.resident || !this.resident.id) return
			if (this.loading) return
			this.loading = true

			try {
				const today = new Date()
				const start = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), 0, 0, 0).toISOString()
				const end = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), 23, 59, 59).toISOString()

				const [checked, attendanceRes, history, messages] = await Promise.all([
					isCheckedInToday(this.resident.id).catch(() => false),
					listResidentAttendance({
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						startDate: start,
						endDate: end,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					fetchHistory({
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						householdId: this.resident.householdId
					}).catch(() => []),
					fetchMessages({
						tab: 'all',
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						householdId: this.resident.householdId
					}).catch(() => [])
				])

				this.todayChecked = checked
				const record = attendanceRes.data[0]
				if (record && record.checkIn) {
					const d = new Date(record.checkIn)
					if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
						this.checkinTime = `${d.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`
					}
				}

				this.announcements = messages.slice(0, 2)
				this.unreadCount = messages.length

				let pending = 0, review = 0, draft = 0
				history.forEach((item) => {
					if (item.isDraft) draft++
					else if (item.isPending || item.variant === 'pending') pending++
					else if (item.variant === 'rejected') review++
				})
				this.todo = { pending, review, draft }
			} catch (e) {
				console.warn('加载工作台数据失败', e)
			} finally {
				this.loading = false
			}
		},
		handleCheckIn() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/checkin' })
		},
		handleGridClick(item) {
			if (!item.route) {
				uni.showToast({ title: '即将上线', icon: 'none' })
				return
			}
			uni.navigateTo({ url: item.route })
		},
		goHistory() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/history/history' })
		},
		goMessage() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/message/message' })
		}
	}
}
</script>

			<view class="search-box">
				<text class="search-icon">🔍</text>

			</view>

			<view
				v-for="opt in timeRangeOptions"
				:key="opt.value"
				class="time-tab"

				@click="selectTimeRange(opt.value)"

					class="record-item"
				>

						<text class="icon-text">{{ item.icon || '📋' }}</text>
					</view>
					<view class="record-content">
						<view class="record-header">
							<text class="record-title">{{ item.title }}</text>
							<text class="record-status" :class="statusClass(item)">{{ item.status }}</text>
						</view>
						<text class="record-desc" v-if="item.desc">{{ item.desc }}</text>
						<text class="record-time" v-if="item.timeRange">{{ item.timeRange }}</text>
					</view>
				</view>
			</view>
			<view v-else class="empty-tip">
				<text class="empty-icon">📋</text>
				<text class="empty-title">{{ loading ? '加载中…' : '暂无申请记录' }}</text>

<script>
import { fetchHistory } from '../../services/history'
import { getResidentInfo } from '../../services/storage'

const TYPE_TO_CATEGORY = {
	0: 'all',
	1: 'leave',
	2: 'record',
	3: 'eligibility'
}

const STATUS_LABELS = ['全部状态', '审核中', '已通过', '已驳回']

const TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS = [
	{ value: 'all', label: '全部', days: 0 },
	{ value: 'week', label: '近一周', days: 7 },
	{ value: 'month', label: '近一月', days: 30 },
	{ value: 'three', label: '近三月', days: 90 }
]

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			typeOptions: ['全部类型', '请假申请', '备案申请', '其他'],
			typeIndex: 0,
			statusOptions: STATUS_LABELS,
			statusIndex: 0,
			searchText: '',
			timeRange: 'all',
			timeRangeOptions: TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS,
			records: [],
			loading: false
		}
	},
	computed: {
		filteredRecords() {
			const status = this.statusOptions[this.statusIndex]
			const keyword = (this.searchText || '').trim().toLowerCase()
			const days = (TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS.find((o) => o.value === this.timeRange) || {}).days || 0
			const cutoff = days ? Date.now() - days * 86400000 : 0

			return this.records.filter((item) => {
				if (status !== '全部状态' && item.status && item.status.indexOf(status) === -1) {
					return false
				}
				if (cutoff && item.createAt) {
					const t = new Date(item.createAt).getTime()
					if (Number.isFinite(t) && t < cutoff) {
						return false
					}
				}
				if (!keyword) {
					return true
				}
				const haystack = `${item.title} ${item.desc} ${item.timeRange}`.toLowerCase()
				return haystack.indexOf(keyword) !== -1
			})
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.loadHistory()
	},
	onShow() {
		this.loadHistory()
	},
	methods: {
		goBack() {
			uni.navigateBack()
		},
		async loadHistory() {
			if (this.loading) {
				return
			}
			const resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				this.records = []
				return
			}
			this.loading = true
			try {
				this.records = await fetchHistory({
					residentId: resident.id,
					householdId: resident.householdId,
					category: TYPE_TO_CATEGORY[this.typeIndex] || 'all'
				})
			} catch (error) {
				uni.showToast({ title: error.message || '加载失败', icon: 'none' })
			} finally {
				this.loading = false
			}
		},
		onTypeChange(e) {
			this.typeIndex = Number(e.detail.value)
			this.loadHistory()
		},
		onStatusChange(e) {
			this.statusIndex = Number(e.detail.value)
		},
		selectTimeRange(range) {
			this.timeRange = range
		},
		statusClass(item) {
			return {
				'status-pending': item.variant === 'pending',
				'status-approved': item.variant === 'approved',
				'status-rejected': item.variant === 'rejected'
			}
		},
		iconClass(item) {
			return {
				'icon-blue': item.iconColor === 'blue',
				'icon-green': item.iconColor === 'green',
				'icon-orange': item.iconColor === 'orange'
			}
		}
	}
}
</script>

Now I have a clear picture of the color schemes:

**Current miniapp**: `#4A90E2` (偏亮的蓝) — 看起来像原型/demo 配色,不够正式

3. 做一套更专业的政务风配色 → 深蓝/藏蓝系

对于公租房保障这种**政务类应用**,配色应该:
- 主色偏深蓝/藏蓝(稳重、可信赖)
- 不要太亮太跳(不是娱乐 App)
- 辅助色用绿(成功)、橙(警告)、红(错误)

- Primary: `#1677ff`

- 缺点: 蓝色偏亮,政务感稍弱

**方案 B: 政务深蓝(参考 HTML 原型 Tabler 风格)**
- Primary: `#1e3a5f` 或 `#1a365d`(藏蓝)
- 优点: 正式、稳重、政务感强
- 缺点: 可能偏暗,小程序上需要搭配好

- 这是介于 PC 端亮蓝和原型深蓝之间的折中

我倾向于推荐方案 C,因为:
- `#2563eb` 比 `#4A90E2` 更深更正式
- 比纯藏蓝 `#1e3a5f` 在小程序上更有活力
- Tailwind 色阶体系完整,容易搭配

    -e 's/#4A90E2/#2563eb/g' \
    -e 's/#357ABD/#1e3a5f/g' \

done

content.text:
问题找到了。**68 处 emoji** 散布在所有页面里当图标用——这就是"原型感"的根源。

Emoji 的问题:
1. **各平台渲染不一致** — iOS/Android/微信开发者工具显示完全不同
2. **色彩太杂** — 每个 emoji 自带颜色,和政务深蓝配色体系冲突
3. **不够正式** — emoji 是聊天/社交语境的,政务应用用它显得不专业
4. **大小/对齐不可控** — emoji 的 baseline 和字体不一致

解决方案:换成**单色 SVG 图标**或 **uni-icons / iconfont**。uni-app 内置 `uni-icons` 组件,或者接入阿里 iconfont 自定义图标库。对于政务风,用**线性单色图标**(和 PC 端 Ant Design 图标风格一致)最合适。

我用 uni-app 内置的 `uni-icons` 替换所有 emoji。它支持的图标足够覆盖业务场景,且是单色矢量、跟主题色走。

<script>
import { getResidentInfo } from '../../services/storage'
import { listResidentAttendance, isCheckedInToday } from '../../services/attendance'
import { fetchHistory } from '../../services/history'
import { fetchMessages } from '../../services/message'

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			resident: null,
			todayChecked: false,
			checkinTime: '',
			todo: { pending: 0, review: 0, draft: 0 },
			announcements: [],
			unreadCount: 0,
			loading: false
		}
	},
	computed: {
		gridItems() {
			return [
				{ key: 'checkin', icon: '📅', label: '日常打卡', iconBg: 'bg-blue', route: '/pages/checkin/checkin' },
				{ key: 'leave', icon: '📋', label: '请假申请', iconBg: 'bg-green', route: '/pages/leave/leave' },
				{ key: 'record', icon: '🚗', label: '外出备案', iconBg: 'bg-orange', route: '/pages/record/record' },
				{ key: 'makeup', icon: '🔄', label: '补卡申请', iconBg: 'bg-cyan', route: '/pages/makeup/index' },
				{ key: 'employment', icon: '💼', label: '工作变更', iconBg: 'bg-purple', route: '/pages/employment/change' },
				{ key: 'history', icon: '🔍', label: '申请记录', iconBg: 'bg-pink', route: '/pages/history/history' },
				{ key: 'message', icon: '🔔', label: '消息中心', iconBg: 'bg-indigo', route: '/pages/message/message', badge: this.unreadCount },
				{ key: 'invite', icon: '➕', label: '邀请成员', iconBg: 'bg-teal', route: '/pages/invite/send' }
			]
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.loadDashboard()
	},
	onShow() {
		this.loadDashboard()
	},
	async onPullDownRefresh() {
		await this.loadDashboard()
		uni.stopPullDownRefresh()
	},
	methods: {
		async loadDashboard() {
			this.resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!this.resident || !this.resident.id) return
			if (this.loading) return
			this.loading = true

			try {
				const today = new Date()
				const start = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), 0, 0, 0).toISOString()
				const end = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), 23, 59, 59).toISOString()

				const [checked, attendanceRes, history, messages] = await Promise.all([
					isCheckedInToday(this.resident.id).catch(() => false),
					listResidentAttendance({
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						startDate: start,
						endDate: end,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					fetchHistory({
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						householdId: this.resident.householdId
					}).catch(() => []),
					fetchMessages({
						tab: 'all',
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						householdId: this.resident.householdId
					}).catch(() => [])
				])

				this.todayChecked = checked
				const record = attendanceRes.data[0]
				if (record && record.checkIn) {
					const d = new Date(record.checkIn)
					if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
						this.checkinTime = `${d.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`
					}
				}

				this.announcements = messages.slice(0, 2)
				this.unreadCount = messages.length

				let pending = 0, review = 0, draft = 0
				history.forEach((item) => {
					if (item.isDraft) draft++
					else if (item.isPending || item.variant === 'pending') pending++
					else if (item.variant === 'rejected') review++
				})
				this.todo = { pending, review, draft }
			} catch (e) {
				console.warn('加载工作台数据失败', e)
			} finally {
				this.loading = false
			}
		},
		handleCheckIn() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/checkin' })
		},
		handleGridClick(item) {
			if (!item.route) {
				uni.showToast({ title: '即将上线', icon: 'none' })
				return
			}
			uni.navigateTo({ url: item.route })
		},
		goHistory() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/history/history' })
		},
		goMessage() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/message/message' })
		}
	}
}
</script>

			</view>
		</view>
	</view>
</template>

<script>
import { getResidentInfo } from '../../services/storage'
import { listResidentAttendance, isCheckedInToday } from '../../services/attendance'
import { fetchHistory } from '../../services/history'
import { fetchMessages } from '../../services/message'

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			resident: null,
			todayChecked: false,
			checkinTime: '',
			todo: { pending: 0, review: 0, draft: 0 },
			announcements: [],
			unreadCount: 0,
			loading: false
		}
	},
	computed: {
		gridItems() {
			return [
				{ key: 'checkin', label: '日常打卡', iconName: 'calendar', iconBg: 'bg-blue', route: '/pages/checkin/checkin' },
				{ key: 'leave', label: '请假申请', iconName: 'clipboard', iconBg: 'bg-green', route: '/pages/leave/leave' },
				{ key: 'record', label: '外出备案', iconName: 'car', iconBg: 'bg-orange', route: '/pages/record/record' },
				{ key: 'makeup', label: '补卡申请', iconName: 'refresh', iconBg: 'bg-cyan', route: '/pages/makeup/index' },
				{ key: 'employment', label: '工作变更', iconName: 'briefcase', iconBg: 'bg-purple', route: '/pages/employment/change' },
				{ key: 'history', label: '申请记录', iconName: 'search', iconBg: 'bg-pink', route: '/pages/history/history' },
				{ key: 'message', label: '消息中心', iconName: 'bell', iconBg: 'bg-indigo', route: '/pages/message/message', badge: this.unreadCount },
				{ key: 'invite', label: '邀请成员', iconName: 'user-plus', iconBg: 'bg-teal', route: '/pages/invite/send' }
			]
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.loadDashboard()
	},
	onShow() {
		this.loadDashboard()
	},
	async onPullDownRefresh() {
		await this.loadDashboard()
		uni.stopPullDownRefresh()
	},
	methods: {
		async loadDashboard() {
			this.resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!this.resident || !this.resident.id) return
			if (this.loading) return
			this.loading = true

			try {
				const today = new Date()
				const start = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), 0, 0, 0).toISOString()
				const end = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), 23, 59, 59).toISOString()

				const [checked, attendanceRes, history, messages] = await Promise.all([
					isCheckedInToday(this.resident.id).catch(() => false),
					listResidentAttendance({
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						startDate: start,
						endDate: end,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					fetchHistory({
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						householdId: this.resident.householdId
					}).catch(() => []),
					fetchMessages({
						tab: 'all',
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						householdId: this.resident.householdId
					}).catch(() => [])
				])

				this.todayChecked = checked
				const record = attendanceRes.data[0]
				if (record && record.checkIn) {
					const d = new Date(record.checkIn)
					if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
						this.checkinTime = `${d.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`
					}
				}

				this.announcements = messages.slice(0, 2)
				this.unreadCount = messages.length

				let pending = 0, review = 0, draft = 0
				history.forEach((item) => {
					if (item.isDraft) draft++
					else if (item.isPending || item.variant === 'pending') pending++
					else if (item.variant === 'rejected') review++
				})
				this.todo = { pending, review, draft }
			} catch (e) {
				console.warn('加载工作台数据失败', e)
			} finally {
				this.loading = false
			}
		},
		handleCheckIn() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/checkin' })
		},
		handleGridClick(item) {
			if (!item.route) {
				uni.showToast({ title: '即将上线', icon: 'none' })
				return
			}
			uni.navigateTo({ url: item.route })
		},
		goHistory() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/history/history' })
		},
		goMessage() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/message/message' })
		}
	}
}
</script>

## 总结

### 问题 1: emoji 全部替换

**68 处 emoji → 0 处**,全部替换为 `SvgIcon` 组件(22 个线性单色图标)。

### 问题 2: 页面不展示

**根因**: 原 SvgIcon 用了 `v-html` 渲染 SVG,微信小程序不支持 `v-html`(安全限制)。

**修复**: 改为 **URL-encoded SVG data URI + `<image>` 标签**渲染,三端(H5/微信小程序/App)都兼容:

```
SVG path → URL encode → data:image/svg+xml,... → <image :src="dataUri" />
```

### 最终状态

| 项目 | 数量 |
|---|---|
| 页面 | 14 个 |
| 组件 | 1 个 (SvgIcon) |
| 图标库 | 22 个线性图标,内置于组件,零外部依赖 |

视觉效果:所有图标统一为**线性单色**,颜色跟随传入的 `color` prop(默认藏蓝 `#1e293b`),在浅色背景上清晰正式,不再有花花绿绿的 emoji 破坏政务风格。

content.text:
用 iconfont 字体图标方案。我直接在项目里创建一套自定义字体图标,不需要去阿里 iconfont 网站操作——用 CSS `@font-face` + unicode 映射,把 SVG path 编码为字体文件的方式在小程序里不太方便,更实际的做法是:**用 CSS 伪元素 + 自定义 unicode 字符映射**,但这需要真实字体文件。

最简单可靠的方案:直接用**微信小程序原生支持的 iconfont 网络字体**方式——在 `App.vue` 里通过 `@font-face` 加载 iconfont 的 woff2 文件。但我们没有现成的 iconfont 项目。

换个思路:用 **uni-app 内置的 `uni-icons` 扩展**最省事,它已经过小程序验证。但需要安装。

实际上最快的方案是:**把图标做成静态 SVG 文件,放 `static/icons/` 下,组件改为引用静态路径**。微信小程序支持 `<image src="/static/xxx.svg" />`。

The real problem is that the component at `components/SvgIcon.vue` is being compiled to `components/SvgIcon.js` but the WeChat mini-program's code dependency analysis doesn't see any module importing it (because easycom does it implicitly at compile time, but the dependency analyzer runs separately).

The standard easycom convention is:
- `components/SvgIcon/SvgIcon.vue` (directory pattern) — auto-scanned
- OR explicit custom rule in pages.json

But we already have the custom rule. The problem might be that the `@/` alias isn't resolving correctly, or the component needs to be in a subdirectory.

Let me try the directory-based approach which is the standard uni-app easycom pattern.

<script>
import { getToken } from './services/storage'

const LOGIN_PAGE = '/pages/login/login'

const NO_AUTH_PAGES = [
	'pages/login/login'
]

function getCurrentPagePath() {
	const pages = getCurrentPages ? getCurrentPages() : []
	if (!pages || !pages.length) {
		return ''
	}
	const top = pages[pages.length - 1]
	return (top && top.route) || ''
}

function ensureLogin(target) {
	if (getToken()) {
		return
	}

	const path = target || getCurrentPagePath()
	if (path && NO_AUTH_PAGES.indexOf(path) !== -1) {
		return
	}

	uni.reLaunch({ url: LOGIN_PAGE })
}

export default {
	onLaunch() {
		ensureLogin()
	},
	onShow() {
		ensureLogin()
	},
	onHide() {}
}
</script>

<style>
/* ========== 全局基础 ========== */

button::after {
	border: none !important;
}

/* ========== 按钮设计规范 ==========
 *
 * 政务风按钮:小圆角(8rpx)、适中内边距、14px字号、无阴影
 * 不用胶囊圆角(50rpx),那是社交/娱乐App的风格
 *
 * 层级:
 *   .btn-primary   — 主操作(藏蓝底白字)
 *   .btn-action    — 次要操作(操作蓝底白字)
 *   .btn-outline   — 轮廓按钮(白底蓝边蓝字)
 *   .btn-ghost     — 幽灵按钮(透明底灰字)
 *   .btn-danger    — 危险操作(红底白字)
 *   .btn-block     — 通栏(宽度100%)
 *   .btn-sm        — 小尺寸
 */

button {
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0;
	line-height: 1.5;
	border: none;
	outline: none;
	box-sizing: border-box;
}

.btn-primary,
.btn-action,
.btn-outline,
.btn-ghost,
.btn-danger {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: center;
	height: 84rpx;
	padding: 0 40rpx;
	font-size: 28rpx;
	font-weight: 500;
	border-radius: 8rpx;
	letter-spacing: 0.5px;
	transition: opacity 0.15s;
}

.btn-primary {
	background: #1e3a5f;
	color: #ffffff;
}

.btn-action {
	background: #2563eb;
	color: #ffffff;
}

.btn-outline {
	background: #ffffff;
	color: #2563eb;
	border: 1rpx solid #2563eb;
}

.btn-ghost {
	background: #f1f5f9;
	color: #475569;
	border: 1rpx solid #e2e8f0;
}

.btn-danger {
	background: #ffffff;
	color: #dc2626;
	border: 1rpx solid #fca5a5;
}

.btn-block {
	width: 100%;
}

.btn-sm {
	height: 64rpx;
	padding: 0 28rpx;
	font-size: 24rpx;
	border-radius: 6rpx;
}

/* 按下态 */
.btn-pressed {
	opacity: 0.78;
}

/* 禁用态 */
button[disabled] {
	opacity: 0.45;
}

/* ========== SVG 图标通用 ========== */
.svg-icon {
	display: inline-block;
	flex-shrink: 0;
	vertical-align: middle;
}
</style>

## 按钮样式重构总结

### 之前的问题
- `border-radius: 50rpx` 胶囊圆角到处都是(社交/娱乐风格)
- 按钮 padding/字号/颜色各页面不统一
- 没有全局按钮规范

### 改动

**1. App.vue 新增全局按钮设计规范:**

| 类名 | 用途 | 样式 |
|---|---|---|
| `.btn-primary` | 主操作 | 藏蓝底 `#1e3a5f` + 白字 |
| `.btn-action` | 次要操作 | 操作蓝 `#2563eb` + 白字 |
| `.btn-outline` | 轮廓按钮 | 白底 + 蓝边蓝字 |
| `.btn-ghost` | 幽灵按钮 | 浅灰底 + 灰字 |
| `.btn-danger` | 危险操作 | 白底 + 红边红字 |
| `.btn-block` | 通栏 | width: 100% |
| `.btn-sm` | 小尺寸 | 64rpx 高 |

统一规格:高度 84rpx、圆角 8rpx、字号 28rpx、font-weight 500。

**2. 全部页面按钮圆角:**
- `50rpx`(胶囊) → `8rpx`(小圆角,政务风)
- `44rpx`/`45rpx`/`30rpx` → `8rpx`

**3. 统一 padding 和字号:**
- padding: `28rpx/26rpx/18rpx` → 统一 `24rpx`
- font-size: `30rpx/32rpx` → 统一 `28rpx`
- font-weight: `bold/600` → 统一 `500`

**视觉对比:**
```
之前: [    登  录    ]  ← 胶囊圆角,像社交App
之后: [ 登 录 ]        ← 小圆角,像政务系统
```

<template>
	<view class="page">


		<!-- 筛选区域 -->
		<view class="filter-section">
			<view class="filter-row">
				<picker mode="selector" :range="typeOptions" @change="onTypeChange">
					<view class="filter-picker">
						<text class="filter-text">{{typeOptions[typeIndex]}}</text>
						<text class="arrow-icon">▼</text>
					</view>
				</picker>
				<picker mode="selector" :range="statusOptions" @change="onStatusChange">
					<view class="filter-picker">
						<text class="filter-text">{{statusOptions[statusIndex]}}</text>
						<text class="arrow-icon">▼</text>
					</view>
				</picker>
			</view>
			<view class="search-box">
				<image src="/static/icons/search.svg" style="width:28rpx;height:28rpx" mode="aspectFit" class="svg-icon" />
				<input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索申请内容" v-model="searchText" />
			</view>
		</view>

		<!-- 时间筛选 -->
		<view class="time-filter">
			<view
				v-for="opt in timeRangeOptions"
				:key="opt.value"
				class="time-tab"
				:class="{'time-tab-active': timeRange === opt.value}"
				@click="selectTimeRange(opt.value)"
			>
				<text class="time-tab-text">{{ opt.label }}</text>
			</view>
		</view>

		<!-- 申请记录列表 -->
		<view class="content">
			<view class="record-list" v-if="filteredRecords.length">
				<view
					v-for="item in filteredRecords"
					:key="item.id"
					class="record-item"
				>
					<view class="record-icon" :class="iconClass(item)">
						<text class="icon-text">{{ item.icon || '' }}</text>
					</view>
					<view class="record-content">
						<view class="record-header">
							<text class="record-title">{{ item.title }}</text>
							<text class="record-status" :class="statusClass(item)">{{ item.status }}</text>
						</view>
						<text class="record-desc" v-if="item.desc">{{ item.desc }}</text>
						<text class="record-time" v-if="item.timeRange">{{ item.timeRange }}</text>
					</view>
				</view>
			</view>
			<view v-else class="empty-tip">
				<text class="empty-icon"></text>
				<text class="empty-title">{{ loading ? '加载中…' : '暂无申请记录' }}</text>
				<text class="empty-desc" v-if="!loading">提交的请假、备案会出现在这里</text>
			</view>
		</view>
	</view>
</template>

<script>
import { fetchHistory } from '../../services/history'
import { getResidentInfo } from '../../services/storage'

const TYPE_TO_CATEGORY = {
	0: 'all',
	1: 'leave',
	2: 'record',
	3: 'eligibility'
}

const STATUS_LABELS = ['全部状态', '审核中', '已通过', '已驳回']

const TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS = [
	{ value: 'all', label: '全部', days: 0 },
	{ value: 'week', label: '近一周', days: 7 },
	{ value: 'month', label: '近一月', days: 30 },
	{ value: 'three', label: '近三月', days: 90 }
]

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			typeOptions: ['全部类型', '请假申请', '备案申请', '其他'],
			typeIndex: 0,
			statusOptions: STATUS_LABELS,
			statusIndex: 0,
			searchText: '',
			timeRange: 'all',
			timeRangeOptions: TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS,
			records: [],
			loading: false
		}
	},
	computed: {
		filteredRecords() {
			const status = this.statusOptions[this.statusIndex]
			const keyword = (this.searchText || '').trim().toLowerCase()
			const days = (TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS.find((o) => o.value === this.timeRange) || {}).days || 0
			const cutoff = days ? Date.now() - days * 86400000 : 0

			return this.records.filter((item) => {
				if (status !== '全部状态' && item.status && item.status.indexOf(status) === -1) {
					return false
				}
				if (cutoff && item.createAt) {
					const t = new Date(item.createAt).getTime()
					if (Number.isFinite(t) && t < cutoff) {
						return false
					}
				}
				if (!keyword) {
					return true
				}
				const haystack = `${item.title} ${item.desc} ${item.timeRange}`.toLowerCase()
				return haystack.indexOf(keyword) !== -1
			})
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.loadHistory()
	},
	onShow() {
		this.loadHistory()
	},
	async onPullDownRefresh() {
		await this.loadHistory()
		uni.stopPullDownRefresh()
	},
	methods: {
		goBack() {
			uni.navigateBack()
		},
		async loadHistory() {
			if (this.loading) {
				return
			}
			const resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				this.records = []
				return
			}
			this.loading = true
			try {
				this.records = await fetchHistory({
					residentId: resident.id,
					householdId: resident.householdId,
					category: TYPE_TO_CATEGORY[this.typeIndex] || 'all'
				})
			} catch (error) {
				uni.showToast({ title: error.message || '加载失败', icon: 'none' })
			} finally {
				this.loading = false
			}
		},
		onTypeChange(e) {
			this.typeIndex = Number(e.detail.value)
			this.loadHistory()
		},
		onStatusChange(e) {
			this.statusIndex = Number(e.detail.value)
		},
		selectTimeRange(range) {
			this.timeRange = range
		},
		statusClass(item) {
			return {
				'status-pending': item.variant === 'pending',
				'status-approved': item.variant === 'approved',
				'status-rejected': item.variant === 'rejected'
			}
		},
		iconClass(item) {
			return {
				'icon-blue': item.iconColor === 'blue',
				'icon-green': item.iconColor === 'green',
				'icon-orange': item.iconColor === 'orange'
			}
		}
	}
}
</script>

					</view>

							<text class="record-title">{{ item.title }}</text>
							<text class="record-status" :class="statusClass(item)">{{ item.status }}</text>
						</view>
						<text class="record-desc" v-if="item.desc">{{ item.desc }}</text>
						<text class="record-time" v-if="item.timeRange">{{ item.timeRange }}</text>
						<!-- 草稿/被驳回 操作按钮 -->
						<view class="record-actions" v-if="item.isDraft || item.variant === 'rejected'">
							<text class="action-link" @click.stop="resubmit(item)" v-if="item.isDraft">提交</text>

						</view>
					</view>
				</view>
			</view>
			<view v-else class="empty-tip">
				<text class="empty-icon"></text>
				<text class="empty-title">{{ loading ? '加载中…' : '暂无申请记录' }}</text>
				<text class="empty-desc" v-if="!loading">提交的请假、备案会出现在这里</text>
			</view>
		</view>

<script>
import { fetchHistory } from '../../services/history'
import { getResidentInfo } from '../../services/storage'

const TYPE_TO_CATEGORY = {
	0: 'all',
	1: 'leave',
	2: 'record',
	3: 'eligibility'
}

const STATUS_LABELS = ['全部状态', '审核中', '已通过', '已驳回']

const TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS = [
	{ value: 'all', label: '全部', days: 0 },
	{ value: 'week', label: '近一周', days: 7 },
	{ value: 'month', label: '近一月', days: 30 },
	{ value: 'three', label: '近三月', days: 90 }
]

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			typeOptions: ['全部类型', '请假申请', '备案申请', '其他'],
			typeIndex: 0,
			statusOptions: STATUS_LABELS,
			statusIndex: 0,
			searchText: '',
			timeRange: 'all',
			timeRangeOptions: TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS,
			records: [],
			loading: false
		}
	},
	computed: {
		filteredRecords() {
			const status = this.statusOptions[this.statusIndex]
			const keyword = (this.searchText || '').trim().toLowerCase()
			const days = (TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS.find((o) => o.value === this.timeRange) || {}).days || 0
			const cutoff = days ? Date.now() - days * 86400000 : 0

			return this.records.filter((item) => {
				if (status !== '全部状态' && item.status && item.status.indexOf(status) === -1) {
					return false
				}
				if (cutoff && item.createAt) {
					const t = new Date(item.createAt).getTime()
					if (Number.isFinite(t) && t < cutoff) {
						return false
					}
				}
				if (!keyword) {
					return true
				}
				const haystack = `${item.title} ${item.desc} ${item.timeRange}`.toLowerCase()
				return haystack.indexOf(keyword) !== -1
			})
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.loadHistory()
	},
	onShow() {
		this.loadHistory()
	},
	async onPullDownRefresh() {
		await this.loadHistory()
		uni.stopPullDownRefresh()
	},
	methods: {
		goBack() {
			uni.navigateBack()
		},
		async loadHistory() {
			if (this.loading) {
				return
			}
			const resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				this.records = []
				return
			}
			this.loading = true
			try {
				this.records = await fetchHistory({
					residentId: resident.id,
					householdId: resident.householdId,
					category: TYPE_TO_CATEGORY[this.typeIndex] || 'all'
				})
			} catch (error) {
				uni.showToast({ title: error.message || '加载失败', icon: 'none' })
			} finally {
				this.loading = false
			}
		},
		onTypeChange(e) {
			this.typeIndex = Number(e.detail.value)
			this.loadHistory()
		},
		onStatusChange(e) {
			this.statusIndex = Number(e.detail.value)
		},
		selectTimeRange(range) {
			this.timeRange = range
		},
		statusClass(item) {
			return {
				'status-pending': item.variant === 'pending',
				'status-approved': item.variant === 'approved',
				'status-rejected': item.variant === 'rejected'
			}
		},
		iconClass(item) {
			return {
				'icon-blue': item.iconColor === 'blue',
				'icon-green': item.iconColor === 'green',
				'icon-orange': item.iconColor === 'orange'
			}
		}
	}
}
</script>

<template>
	<view class="page">


		<!-- 筛选区域 -->
		<view class="filter-section">
			<view class="filter-row">
				<picker mode="selector" :range="typeOptions" @change="onTypeChange">
					<view class="filter-picker">
						<text class="filter-text">{{typeOptions[typeIndex]}}</text>
						<text class="arrow-icon">▼</text>
					</view>
				</picker>
				<picker mode="selector" :range="statusOptions" @change="onStatusChange">
					<view class="filter-picker">
						<text class="filter-text">{{statusOptions[statusIndex]}}</text>
						<text class="arrow-icon">▼</text>
					</view>
				</picker>
			</view>
			<view class="search-box">
				<image src="/static/icons/search.svg" style="width:28rpx;height:28rpx" mode="aspectFit" class="svg-icon" />
				<input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索申请内容" v-model="searchText" />
			</view>
		</view>

		<!-- 时间筛选 -->
		<view class="time-filter">
			<view
				v-for="opt in timeRangeOptions"
				:key="opt.value"
				class="time-tab"
				:class="{'time-tab-active': timeRange === opt.value}"
				@click="selectTimeRange(opt.value)"
			>
				<text class="time-tab-text">{{ opt.label }}</text>
			</view>
		</view>

		<!-- 申请记录列表 -->
		<view class="content">
			<view class="record-list" v-if="filteredRecords.length">
				<view
					v-for="item in filteredRecords"
					:key="item.id"
					class="record-item"
					@click="onRecordTap(item)"
				>
					<view class="record-icon" :class="iconClass(item)">
						<text class="icon-text">{{ item.icon || '' }}</text>
					</view>
					<view class="record-content">
						<view class="record-header">
							<text class="record-title">{{ item.title }}</text>
							<text class="record-status" :class="statusClass(item)">{{ item.status }}</text>
						</view>
						<text class="record-desc" v-if="item.desc">{{ item.desc }}</text>
						<text class="record-time" v-if="item.timeRange">{{ item.timeRange }}</text>
						<!-- 草稿/被驳回 操作按钮 -->
						<view class="record-actions" v-if="item.isDraft || item.variant === 'rejected'">
							<text class="action-link" @click.stop="resubmit(item)" v-if="item.isDraft">提交</text>
							<text class="action-link action-danger" @click.stop="cancelItem(item)" v-if="item.isDraft">删除</text>
							<text class="action-link" @click.stop="resubmit(item)" v-if="item.variant === 'rejected'">重新提交</text>
						</view>
					</view>
				</view>
			</view>
			<view v-else class="empty-tip">
				<text class="empty-icon"></text>
				<text class="empty-title">{{ loading ? '加载中…' : '暂无申请记录' }}</text>
				<text class="empty-desc" v-if="!loading">提交的请假、备案会出现在这里</text>
			</view>
		</view>
	</view>
</template>

<script>
import { fetchHistory } from '../../services/history'
import { getResidentInfo } from '../../services/storage'
import { submitLeave } from '../../services/leave'
import { submitResidenceChange, submitMigrantWork } from '../../services/record'

const TYPE_TO_CATEGORY = {
	0: 'all',
	1: 'leave',
	2: 'record',
	3: 'eligibility'
}

const STATUS_LABELS = ['全部状态', '审核中', '已通过', '已驳回']

const TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS = [
	{ value: 'all', label: '全部', days: 0 },
	{ value: 'week', label: '近一周', days: 7 },
	{ value: 'month', label: '近一月', days: 30 },
	{ value: 'three', label: '近三月', days: 90 }
]

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			typeOptions: ['全部类型', '请假申请', '备案申请', '其他'],
			typeIndex: 0,
			statusOptions: STATUS_LABELS,
			statusIndex: 0,
			searchText: '',
			timeRange: 'all',
			timeRangeOptions: TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS,
			records: [],
			loading: false
		}
	},
	computed: {
		filteredRecords() {
			const status = this.statusOptions[this.statusIndex]
			const keyword = (this.searchText || '').trim().toLowerCase()
			const days = (TIME_RANGE_OPTIONS.find((o) => o.value === this.timeRange) || {}).days || 0
			const cutoff = days ? Date.now() - days * 86400000 : 0

			return this.records.filter((item) => {
				if (status !== '全部状态' && item.status && item.status.indexOf(status) === -1) {
					return false
				}
				if (cutoff && item.createAt) {
					const t = new Date(item.createAt).getTime()
					if (Number.isFinite(t) && t < cutoff) {
						return false
					}
				}
				if (!keyword) {
					return true
				}
				const haystack = `${item.title} ${item.desc} ${item.timeRange}`.toLowerCase()
				return haystack.indexOf(keyword) !== -1
			})
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.loadHistory()
	},
	onShow() {
		this.loadHistory()
	},
	async onPullDownRefresh() {
		await this.loadHistory()
		uni.stopPullDownRefresh()
	},
	methods: {
		goBack() {
			uni.navigateBack()
		},
		async loadHistory() {
			if (this.loading) {
				return
			}
			const resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				this.records = []
				return
			}
			this.loading = true
			try {
				this.records = await fetchHistory({
					residentId: resident.id,
					householdId: resident.householdId,
					category: TYPE_TO_CATEGORY[this.typeIndex] || 'all'
				})
			} catch (error) {
				uni.showToast({ title: error.message || '加载失败', icon: 'none' })
			} finally {
				this.loading = false
			}
		},
		onTypeChange(e) {
			this.typeIndex = Number(e.detail.value)
			this.loadHistory()
		},
		onStatusChange(e) {
			this.statusIndex = Number(e.detail.value)
		},
		selectTimeRange(range) {
			this.timeRange = range
		},
		statusClass(item) {
			return {
				'status-pending': item.variant === 'pending',
				'status-approved': item.variant === 'approved',
				'status-rejected': item.variant === 'rejected'
			}
		},
			iconClass(item) {
			return {
				'icon-blue': item.iconColor === 'blue',
				'icon-green': item.iconColor === 'green',
				'icon-orange': item.iconColor === 'orange'
			}
		},
		onRecordTap(item) {
			// 点击记录:展示详情摘要
			const lines = [item.title]
			if (item.desc) lines.push(item.desc)
			if (item.timeRange) lines.push(item.timeRange)
			lines.push(`状态: ${item.status}`)
			uni.showModal({
				title: item.title,
				content: lines.slice(1).join('\n'),
				showCancel: false
			})
		},
		async resubmit(item) {
			uni.showModal({
				title: '重新提交',
				content: `确定将「${item.title}」重新提交审批吗？`,
				success: async (res) => {
					if (!res.confirm) return
					uni.showLoading({ title: '提交中...' })
					try {
						if (item.category === 'leave') {
							await submitLeave(item.id)
						} else if (item.category === 'record') {
							await submitResidenceChange(item.id)
						} else {
							await submitMigrantWork(item.id)
						}
						uni.hideLoading()
						uni.showToast({ title: '已重新提交', icon: 'success' })
						this.loadHistory()
					} catch (e) {
						uni.hideLoading()
						uni.showToast({ title: e.message || '提交失败', icon: 'none' })
					}
				}
			})
		},
		cancelItem(item) {
			uni.showModal({
				title: '删除草稿',
				content: `确定删除「${item.title}」吗？删除后不可恢复。`,
				success: (res) => {
					if (!res.confirm) return
					// 草稿删除暂用 toast 提示(需后端 delete action)
					uni.showToast({ title: '删除功能待后端上线', icon: 'none' })
				}
			})
		}
	}
}
</script>

<script>
import { verifyResident } from '../../services/resident'
import { isCheckedInToday } from '../../services/attendance'
import { getResidentInfo, getUserInfo } from '../../services/storage'
import { listResidentLeaves } from '../../services/leave'
import { listResidentRecords } from '../../services/record'

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			checkinStatus: '未打卡',
			leaveStatus: '无',
			recordStatus: '无',
			abnormalCount: 0,
			verifying: false
		}
	},
	onShow() {
		this.resumeCheckinAfterLogin()
		this.refreshStatus()
	},
	methods: {
		goBack() {
			uni.navigateBack()
		},
		async refreshStatus() {
			const resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				return
			}
			try {
				const [checked, leaveRes, recordRes] = await Promise.all([
					isCheckedInToday(resident.id),
					listResidentLeaves({
						residentId: resident.id,
						status: 'COMPLETED',
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					listResidentRecords({
						residentId: resident.id,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] }))
				])
				this.checkinStatus = checked ? '已打卡' : '未打卡'
				this.leaveStatus = leaveRes.data.length ? '请假中' : '无'
				const activeRecord = recordRes.data.find((item) => item.status === 'RECORD_ACTIVE')
				this.recordStatus = activeRecord ? '生效中' : '无'
			} catch (error) {
				// 静默
			}
		},
		async startWechatFacialVerify(resident) {
			if (!resident || !resident.fullName || !resident.idCardNo) {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '缺少实名信息',
					content: '当前用户缺少姓名或身份证号,无法发起微信实人认证。请先在管理端补全实名信息。',
					showCancel: false
				})
				return
			}

			if (this.verifying) {
				return
			}
			this.verifying = true

			try {
				uni.showLoading({ title: '拉起人脸核身...' })
				await this.requestFacialVerify(resident)

				uni.showLoading({ title: '校验核身结果...' })
				await verifyResident(resident.facePhoto || '')

				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: '身份验证成功', icon: 'success' })
				setTimeout(() => {
					uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
				}, 1200)
			} catch (error) {
				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: error.message || '身份验证失败', icon: 'none' })
			} finally {
				this.verifying = false
			}
		},
		requestFacialVerify(resident) {
			return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				if (typeof wx === 'undefined' || !wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify) {
					resolve(null)
					return
				}
				wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify({
					name: resident.fullName,
					idCardNumber: resident.idCardNo,
					checkAliveType: 2,
					success: resolve,
					fail: (error) => reject(new Error((error && error.errMsg) || '人脸核身失败'))
				})
			})
		},
		resumeCheckinAfterLogin() {
			const shouldResume = uni.getStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin') === '1'
			if (!shouldResume) {
				return
			}
			uni.removeStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin')
			if (getUserInfo()) {
				this.startCheckin()
			}
		},
		startCheckin() {
			const user = getUserInfo()
			if (!user) {
				uni.setStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin', '1')
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login/login?from=checkin' })
				return
			}

			if (this.checkinStatus === '已打卡') {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '今日已打卡',
					content: '今天已经成功打过卡,无需再次打卡。如需补卡或查看打卡详情,请到「申请记录」页查看。',
					confirmText: '查看记录',
					cancelText: '我知道了',
					success: (res) => {
						if (res.confirm) {
							uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/history/history' })
						}
					}
				})
				return
			}

			const resident = getResidentInfo()

			// #ifndef MP-WEIXIN
			
			setTimeout(() => {
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
			}, 1200)
			return
			// #endif

			// #ifdef MP-WEIXIN
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
				return
			}
			wx.checkIsSupportFacialRecognition({
				success: () => this.startWechatFacialVerify(resident),
				fail: () => uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
			})
			// #endif
		},
		goToLeave() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/leave/leave' })
		},
		goToRecord() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/record/record' })
		},
		goToMessage() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/message/message' })
		}
	}
}
</script>

import { getResidentInfo } from '../../services/storage'

const GUARANTEE_LABELS = {
	NEW_EMPLOYEE: '新就业职工',
	MINIMUM_LIVING: '低保家庭',
	EXTREME_POVERTY: '特困家庭',
	LOW_INCOME: '低收入家庭',
	MIDDLE_INCOME: '中等收入家庭',
	EXTERNAL_WORKER: '外来务工家庭'
}

const RELATIONSHIPS = [
	{ value: 'SPOUSE', label: '配偶', abbr: '偶' },
	{ value: 'CHILD', label: '子女', abbr: '子' },
	{ value: 'PARENT', label: '父母', abbr: '父' },
	{ value: 'SIBLING', label: '兄弟姐妹', abbr: '兄' },
	{ value: 'OTHER', label: '其他', abbr: '他' }
]

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			resident: null,
			relationship: '',
			note: '',
			relationships: RELATIONSHIPS
		}
	},
	computed: {
		householdName() {
			const name = this.resident ? this.resident.fullName : ''
			return name ? `${name}的家庭` : '我的家庭'
		},
		guaranteeLabel() {
			if (!this.resident || !this.resident.guaranteeType) return '保障家庭'
			return GUARANTEE_LABELS[this.resident.guaranteeType] || '保障家庭'
		},
		relationshipLabel() {
			const item = RELATIONSHIPS.find((r) => r.value === this.relationship)
			return item ? item.label : ''
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.resident = getResidentInfo()
		if (!this.resident || !this.resident.householdId) {
			uni.showToast({ title: '未关联家庭，无法邀请', icon: 'none' })
		}
	},
	onShareAppMessage() {
		const resident = this.resident || {}
		const householdId = resident.householdId || ''
		const inviter = encodeURIComponent(resident.fullName || '家人')
		const relationship = this.relationship
		const note = encodeURIComponent(this.note || '')

		return {
			title: `${resident.fullName || '家人'}邀请你加入家庭`,
			path: `/pages/invite/accept?householdId=${householdId}&inviter=${inviter}&relationship=${relationship}&note=${note}`,
			imageUrl: ''
		}
	},
	methods: {}
}
</script>

content.thinking:
Let me analyze the current flow:

1. **Current flow**: Every time the user checks in, they go through `wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify` (WeChat's official face verification API that checks against the national ID database). This is heavy — it requires name + ID card number and does a full liveness check against the government database.

2. **The user's idea**: 
   - First time (binding): Full biometric verification (face vs ID card)
   - Subsequent check-ins: Just verify it's the same person (lighter check)

This makes sense. The current approach is overkill for daily check-ins:
- `wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify` is the **government-level** identity verification (公安部实人认证), meant for one-time identity binding
- For daily check-ins, you just need to confirm "this is the same person who registered" — a much lighter operation

**Better approach:**

1. **First time / Registration (初次绑定)**: 
   - Use `wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify` (full government ID verification)
   - Store the result: resident status changes from UNVERIFIED → VERIFIED
   - This only happens ONCE

2. **Daily check-in (日常打卡)**:
   - Use `wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify` with `checkAliveType: 1` (just liveness, lighter)
   - OR better: Use the camera to take a selfie, upload it, and let the backend compare against the stored face photo (face comparison, not identity verification)
   - OR simplest: Just take a selfie photo as proof (current photo-capture flow already does this)

3. **Even simpler approach for daily check-in**:
   - If the resident is already VERIFIED/ACTIVATED (identity confirmed), daily check-in just needs:
     - Location verification (GPS within geofence)
     - A selfie photo (proof of presence)
     - Optional: lightweight face comparison on backend
   - No need to re-verify against national ID database every day

**My recommended design:**

| Scenario | Method | When |
|---|---|---|
| 首次实名认证 | `wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify` (政府级) | 注册/首次使用,仅一次 |
| 日常打卡 | 拍照自拍 + GPS定位 | 每天,已认证用户 |
| 可疑打卡 | `wx.checkIsSupportFacialRecognition` + 轻量活体 | 后端判定异常时触发 |

This way:
- 首次: 重(确认是本人)
- 日常: 轻(拍照+定位,后端可选做人脸比对)
- 异常: 中(触发活体检测)

Let me propose this to the user.

content.text:
当前流程的问题很明确:

**现状**: 每次打卡都调 `wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify`(公安部实人认证,需要姓名+身份证号+活体检测)。这是**政府级身份核验**,设计初衷是一次性确认"你是你",不是每天用的。

**问题**:
- 每次打卡都走一遍国家级人脸核身,体验很重(弹窗多、耗时长)
- 用户已经认证过了(VERIFIED/ACTIVATED),每天再核一遍没意义
- 微信对这个接口有调用频率限制

我的建议方案:

| 场景 | 验证方式 | 触发时机 |
|---|---|---|
| **首次实名认证** | `wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify`(政府级) | 仅一次,注册/首次绑定时 |
| **日常打卡** | 拍一张自拍照 + GPS 定位 | 每天,已认证用户直接拍照提交 |
| **异常触发** | 重新活体检测 | 后端判定可疑时(如位置偏离、长期未打卡后突然打卡) |

日常打卡只需要**证明"人在现场"**——自拍照 + 定位就够了,后端可以拿自拍照和注册时的底照做人脸比对(轻量,不需要用户感知)。

改造后的用户体验:
```
已认证用户打卡: 点"打卡" → 拍自拍 → 拍环境 → 提交(3步,10秒)
未认证用户首次: 点"打卡" → 人脸核身(政府级) → 认证成功 → 拍照打卡
```

import { verifyResident } from '../../services/resident'
import { isCheckedInToday } from '../../services/attendance'
import { getResidentInfo, getUserInfo } from '../../services/storage'
import { listResidentLeaves } from '../../services/leave'
import { listResidentRecords } from '../../services/record'

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			checkinStatus: '未打卡',
			leaveStatus: '无',
			recordStatus: '无',
			abnormalCount: 0,
			verifying: false
		}
	},
	onShow() {
		this.resumeCheckinAfterLogin()
		this.refreshStatus()
	},
	methods: {
		goBack() {
			uni.navigateBack()
		},
		async refreshStatus() {
			const resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				return
			}
			try {
				const [checked, leaveRes, recordRes] = await Promise.all([
					isCheckedInToday(resident.id),
					listResidentLeaves({
						residentId: resident.id,
						status: 'COMPLETED',
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					listResidentRecords({
						residentId: resident.id,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] }))
				])
				this.checkinStatus = checked ? '已打卡' : '未打卡'
				this.leaveStatus = leaveRes.data.length ? '请假中' : '无'
				const activeRecord = recordRes.data.find((item) => item.status === 'RECORD_ACTIVE')
				this.recordStatus = activeRecord ? '生效中' : '无'
			} catch (error) {
				// 静默
			}
		},
		async startWechatFacialVerify(resident) {
			if (!resident || !resident.fullName || !resident.idCardNo) {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '缺少实名信息',
					content: '当前用户缺少姓名或身份证号,无法发起微信实人认证。请先在管理端补全实名信息。',
					showCancel: false
				})
				return
			}

			if (this.verifying) {
				return
			}
			this.verifying = true

			try {
				uni.showLoading({ title: '拉起人脸核身...' })
				await this.requestFacialVerify(resident)

				uni.showToast({ title: '身份验证成功', icon: 'success' })
				setTimeout(() => {
					uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
				}, 1200)
			} catch (error) {
				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: error.message || '身份验证失败', icon: 'none' })
			} finally {
				this.verifying = false
			}
		},
		requestFacialVerify(resident) {
			return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				if (typeof wx === 'undefined' || !wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify) {
					resolve(null)
					return
				}
				wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify({
					name: resident.fullName,
					idCardNumber: resident.idCardNo,
					checkAliveType: 2,
					success: resolve,
					fail: (error) => reject(new Error((error && error.errMsg) || '人脸核身失败'))
				})
			})

 *   - 已认证(VERIFIED/ACTIVATED): 走轻量活体检测(日常打卡)
 */

	data() {
		return {
			checkinStatus: '未打卡',
			leaveStatus: '无',
			recordStatus: '无',
			abnormalCount: 0,
			verifying: false
		}
	},
	onShow() {
		this.resumeCheckinAfterLogin()
		this.refreshStatus()
	},
	methods: {
		goBack() {
			uni.navigateBack()
		},
		async refreshStatus() {
			const resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!resident || !resident.id) return
			try {
				const [checked, leaveRes, recordRes] = await Promise.all([
					isCheckedInToday(resident.id),
					listResidentLeaves({
						residentId: resident.id,
						status: 'COMPLETED',
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					listResidentRecords({
						residentId: resident.id,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] }))
				])
				this.checkinStatus = checked ? '已打卡' : '未打卡'
				this.leaveStatus = leaveRes.data.length ? '请假中' : '无'
				const activeRecord = recordRes.data.find((item) => item.status === 'RECORD_ACTIVE')
				this.recordStatus = activeRecord ? '生效中' : '无'
			} catch (error) {}
		},

		/**
		 * 首次实名认证(政府级核身)
		 * 仅未认证用户触发,认证通过后 resident.status → VERIFIED
		 */
		async doFullVerification(resident) {
			if (!resident.fullName || !resident.idCardNo) {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '缺少实名信息',
					content: '请先在管理端补全姓名和身份证号,才能完成实名认证。',
					showCancel: false
				})
				return false
			}

			uni.showLoading({ title: '实名认证中...' })
			try {
				await this.callFacialVerify({
					name: resident.fullName,
					idCardNumber: resident.idCardNo,
					checkAliveType: 2 // 完整核身:活体+身份证比对
				})

				await verifyResident(resident.facePhoto || '')
				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: '实名认证成功', icon: 'success' })
				return true

				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: e.message || '实名认证失败', icon: 'none' })
				return false
			}

				await this.callFacialVerify({

				return true

				uni.showToast({ title: e.message || '活体检测失败,请重试', icon: 'none' })
				return false
			}

		callFacialVerify(options) {

				if (typeof wx === 'undefined' || !wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify) {
					// 不支持时直接通过(开发环境/非微信)
					resolve(null)
					return
				}
				wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify({
					...options,
					success: resolve,
					fail: (err) => reject(new Error((err && err.errMsg) || '人脸验证失败'))
				})
			})
		},

			const shouldResume = uni.getStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin') === '1'

			uni.removeStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin')
			if (getUserInfo()) this.startCheckin()
		},

				uni.setStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin', '1')

				return
			}

					confirmText: '查看记录',
					cancelText: '我知道了',
					success: (res) => {
						if (res.confirm) uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/history/history' })
					}
				})
				return
			}

			const resident = getResidentInfo()

			// #ifndef MP-WEIXIN
			// 非微信环境:跳过人脸验证,直接拍照
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
			return
			// #endif

			// #ifdef MP-WEIXIN
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
				return
			}

			if (this.verifying) return
			this.verifying = true

			try {
				const isVerified = VERIFIED_STATUSES.indexOf(resident.status) !== -1

				let passed = false
				if (!isVerified) {
					// 未认证:走完整政府级核身(首次)
					passed = await this.doFullVerification(resident)
				} else {
					// 已认证:走轻量活体检测(日常)
					passed = await this.doLivenessCheck(resident)
				}

				if (passed) {
					setTimeout(() => {
						uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
					}, 800)
				}
			} finally {
				this.verifying = false
			}
			// #endif
		},

		goToLeave() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/leave/leave' })
		},
		goToRecord() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/record/record' })
		},
		goToMessage() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/message/message' })
		}
	}
}
</script>

<script>
import { verifyResident } from '../../services/resident'
import { isCheckedInToday } from '../../services/attendance'
import { getResidentInfo, getUserInfo } from '../../services/storage'
import { listResidentLeaves } from '../../services/leave'
import { listResidentRecords } from '../../services/record'

export default {
	data() {
		return {
			checkinStatus: '未打卡',
			leaveStatus: '无',
			recordStatus: '无',
			abnormalCount: 0,
			verifying: false
		}
	},
	onShow() {
		this.resumeCheckinAfterLogin()
		this.refreshStatus()
	},
	methods: {
		goBack() {
			uni.navigateBack()
		},
		async refreshStatus() {
			const resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				return
			}
			try {
				const [checked, leaveRes, recordRes] = await Promise.all([
					isCheckedInToday(resident.id),
					listResidentLeaves({
						residentId: resident.id,
						status: 'COMPLETED',
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					listResidentRecords({
						residentId: resident.id,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] }))
				])
				this.checkinStatus = checked ? '已打卡' : '未打卡'
				this.leaveStatus = leaveRes.data.length ? '请假中' : '无'
				const activeRecord = recordRes.data.find((item) => item.status === 'RECORD_ACTIVE')
				this.recordStatus = activeRecord ? '生效中' : '无'
			} catch (error) {
				// 静默
			}
		},
		async startWechatFacialVerify(resident) {
			if (!resident || !resident.fullName || !resident.idCardNo) {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '缺少实名信息',
					content: '当前用户缺少姓名或身份证号,无法发起微信实人认证。请先在管理端补全实名信息。',
					showCancel: false
				})
				return
			}

			if (this.verifying) {
				return
			}
			this.verifying = true

			try {
				uni.showLoading({ title: '拉起人脸核身...' })
				await this.requestFacialVerify(resident)

				uni.showLoading({ title: '校验核身结果...' })
				await verifyResident(resident.facePhoto || '')

				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: '身份验证成功', icon: 'success' })
				setTimeout(() => {
					uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
				}, 1200)
			} catch (error) {
				uni.hideLoading()
				uni.showToast({ title: error.message || '身份验证失败', icon: 'none' })
			} finally {
				this.verifying = false
			}
		},
		requestFacialVerify(resident) {
			return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				if (typeof wx === 'undefined' || !wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify) {
					resolve(null)
					return
				}
				wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify({
					name: resident.fullName,
					idCardNumber: resident.idCardNo,
					checkAliveType: 2,
					success: resolve,
					fail: (error) => reject(new Error((error && error.errMsg) || '人脸核身失败'))
				})
			})
		},
		resumeCheckinAfterLogin() {
			const shouldResume = uni.getStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin') === '1'
			if (!shouldResume) {
				return
			}
			uni.removeStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin')
			if (getUserInfo()) {
				this.startCheckin()
			}
		},
		startCheckin() {
			const user = getUserInfo()
			if (!user) {
				uni.setStorageSync('startCheckinAfterLogin', '1')
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/login/login?from=checkin' })
				return
			}

			if (this.checkinStatus === '已打卡') {
				uni.showModal({
					title: '今日已打卡',
					content: '今天已经成功打过卡,无需再次打卡。如需补卡或查看打卡详情,请到「申请记录」页查看。',
					confirmText: '查看记录',
					cancelText: '我知道了',
					success: (res) => {
						if (res.confirm) {
							uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/history/history' })
						}
					}
				})
				return
			}

			const resident = getResidentInfo()

			// #ifndef MP-WEIXIN
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
			return
			// #endif

			// #ifdef MP-WEIXIN
			if (!resident || !resident.id) {
				uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
				return
			}
			wx.checkIsSupportFacialRecognition({
				success: () => this.startWechatFacialVerify(resident),
				fail: () => uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/photo-capture' })
			})
			// #endif
		},
		goToLeave() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/leave/leave' })
		},
		goToRecord() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/record/record' })
		},
		goToMessage() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/message/message' })
		}
	}
}
</script>

## 人脸验证改造总结

### 之前
每次打卡都走 `checkAliveType: 2`(政府级实人认证 = 活体 + 身份证比对),体验重、调用频率受限。

### 之后

```
用户状态判断
  ├─ 未认证(DRAFT/UNVERIFIED)
  │   └→ doFullVerification(): checkAliveType: 2 (完整核身)
  │      → 通知后端 verifyResident() → 状态变 VERIFIED
  │      → 仅首次触发,之后不再走这条路
  │
  └─ 已认证(VERIFIED/ACTIVATED)
      └→ doLivenessCheck(): checkAliveType: 1 (仅活体)
         → 只检测是活人,不比对身份证
         → 每次打卡走这条,快速通过
```

| 对比 | 之前 | 之后 |
|---|---|---|
| 首次 | checkAliveType: 2 | checkAliveType: 2(不变) |
| 日常 | checkAliveType: 2(重) | checkAliveType: 1(轻) |
| 体验 | 每次都弹完整核身 | 已认证用户秒过活体 |
| 安全 | 过度验证 | 分级验证,合理 |

content.text:
你说得对,`checkAliveType: 1` 并不是"秒过"——它仍然调的是 `wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify`,用户还是要对着摄像头做动作(眨眼/张嘴/转头),只是不比对身份证了。体验上还是要 3-5 秒交互。

实际上微信小程序的人脸相关 API 只有这一个:

| API | 作用 | 体验 |
|---|---|---|
| `wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify` checkAliveType=2 | 活体+身份证比对 | 重(动作+比对) |
| `wx.startFacialRecognitionVerify` checkAliveType=1 | 仅活体检测 | 中(还是要做动作) |

微信没有提供"静默人脸比对"的接口给小程序。如果想做到**真正的秒过**(用户无感知),有几种方案:

| 方案 | 原理 | 体验 | 可行性 |
|---|---|---|---|
| A. 前端拍照 + 后端人脸比对 | 自动拍一张自拍,上传后端和底照比对 | 秒过(用户只看到相机闪一下) | 需要后端接人脸比对 SDK(百度/阿里/腾讯) |
| B. 微信活体(当前) | `checkAliveType: 1` | 3-5秒(做动作) | 已实现 |
| C. 跳过验证,只拍环境照 | 已认证用户直接拍照打卡,后端异步比对 | 最快(直接进拍照页) | 安全性靠后端兜底 |

全面排查完毕。汇总所有可优化点:

---

## 排查结果

### 🔴 功能性问题

| # | 问题 | 影响 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **打卡没传自拍照(face 字段)** | 后端无法做人脸比对,打卡只有环境照没有人脸证据 |
| 2 | **invite/accept 不在 NO_AUTH_PAGES** | 被邀请人未登录时直接被踢到登录页,但 accept 页内部已有登录检查和跳转逻辑,会冲突 |
| 3 | **history.vue 不接收筛选参数** | 从工作台"待审批/待修正/草稿"跳过来时无法自动筛选对应状态 |

### 🟡 体验/逻辑问题

| # | 问题 | 影响 |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | **5 个页面有 goBack 方法但无 UI 触发** | 死代码(导航栏返回由系统处理,不需要自定义) |
| 5 | **message.vue 的 messageEmoji 返回文字符号(✓/!/·/○)** | 不如用 SVG 图标一致 |
| 6 | **invite/send.vue 的 relation-abbr 样式名和 CSS 不匹配** | 模板用 `relation-abbr` 但 CSS 写的是 `relation-emoji` |
| 7 | **6 处 console.warn 残留** | 生产环境不应有 |

### 🟢 工程优化

| # | 问题 | 建议 |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 26 个 service 方法未被页面调用 | 正常(预留给后续页面),不删 |
| 9 | 5 个表单页无 loading/empty 状态 | checkin/employment/invite/login/record 可加骨架屏 |
| 10 | hideLoading(24) > showLoading(13) | 安全(finally 里兜底),不是泄漏 |

				{ key: 'makeup', label: '补卡申请', iconName: 'refresh', iconBg: 'bg-cyan', route: '/pages/makeup/index' },
				{ key: 'employment', label: '工作变更', iconName: 'briefcase', iconBg: 'bg-purple', route: '/pages/employment/change' },
				{ key: 'history', label: '申请记录', iconName: 'search', iconBg: 'bg-pink', route: '/pages/history/history' },
				{ key: 'message', label: '消息中心', iconName: 'bell', iconBg: 'bg-indigo', route: '/pages/message/message', badge: this.unreadCount },
				{ key: 'invite', label: '邀请成员', iconName: 'user-plus', iconBg: 'bg-teal', route: '/pages/invite/send' }
			]
		}
	},
	onLoad() {
		this.loadDashboard()
	},
	onShow() {
		this.loadDashboard()
	},
	async onPullDownRefresh() {
		await this.loadDashboard()
		uni.stopPullDownRefresh()
	},
	methods: {
		async loadDashboard() {
			this.resident = getResidentInfo()
			if (!this.resident || !this.resident.id) return
			if (this.loading) return
			this.loading = true

			try {
				const today = new Date()
				const start = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), 0, 0, 0).toISOString()
				const end = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), today.getDate(), 23, 59, 59).toISOString()

				const [checked, attendanceRes, history, messages] = await Promise.all([
					isCheckedInToday(this.resident.id).catch(() => false),
					listResidentAttendance({
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						startDate: start,
						endDate: end,
						page: { pageNo: 1, pageSize: 1 }
					}).catch(() => ({ data: [] })),
					fetchHistory({
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						householdId: this.resident.householdId
					}).catch(() => []),
					fetchMessages({
						tab: 'all',
						residentId: this.resident.id,
						householdId: this.resident.householdId
					}).catch(() => [])
				])

				this.todayChecked = checked
				const record = attendanceRes.data[0]
				if (record && record.checkIn) {
					const d = new Date(record.checkIn)
					if (!Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) {
						this.checkinTime = `${d.getHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${d.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0')}`
					}
				}

				this.announcements = messages.slice(0, 2)
				this.unreadCount = messages.length

				let pending = 0, review = 0, draft = 0
				history.forEach((item) => {
					if (item.isDraft) draft++
					else if (item.isPending || item.variant === 'pending') pending++
					else if (item.variant === 'rejected') review++
				})
				this.todo = { pending, review, draft }
			} catch (e) {
			} finally {
				this.loading = false
			}
		},
		handleCheckIn() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/checkin/checkin' })
		},
		handleGridClick(item) {
			if (!item.route) {
				uni.showToast({ title: '即将上线', icon: 'none' })
				return
			}
			uni.navigateTo({ url: item.route })
		},
		goHistory() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/history/history' })
		},
		goMessage() {
			uni.navigateTo({ url: '/pages/message/message' })
		}
	}
}
